hypothesis: Use of mature, low-LBD learned clauses as antecedent reasons in 1-UIP conflict analysis may identify search states where in-process restartint=50 at conflict >=2048 helps, more meaningfully than R21 direct implication counters.
scientific_scope: Exploratory prospective trial. R21 retrospective observations motivated feature selection; all R22 CNFs must be distinct by content SHA and fixed before results. Synthetic Random3/Community3 are not official.

instrumentation.base: R21 ABI-safe clause-content sidecar and source instrumentation, no clause struct change
instrumentation.antecedent_role: deduce.c mark_clause_as_used(solver,reason,true) only, separate from initial conflict clause and direct implication assignment
instrumentation.lbd: c->glue <= 4, before promotion of learned reason clause
instrumentation.mature: conservatively estimated age >=256 conflicts by order-insensitive double clause-content signature and birth registry, unknown identity receives age 0; repeated content latest birth
instrumentation.windows: actual checkpoint >=256, >=512, >=1024, with overshoots captured and reported
instrumentation.limitation: Signature-based birth age is conservative approximation, not exact object age. Implication and conflict-chain roles are separate. Counter observation alone does not imply causality.

preregistered_frozen_rule.inverse: n>=220 and not trigger, same switch and no clause resets
preregistered_frozen_rule.rationale: R21 historical n240/test shard mature conflict-chain low-LBD reason share rose from mean ~0.087 in earlier interval to ~0.167 in later; a lack of mature-low-LBD chain use is treated as possible stagnation. Thresholds are exploratory and frozen before R22 outcomes.

validation.primary: 60 brand-new random3_test identities; native R22_chain50 vs same compiled binary monitor, PAR2 percentage gain with 95% stratified bootstrap of FORMULAS. Require lower CI >0 AND no excessive >2x regressions for promotion.
secondary: all 16 raw shards, 3840 native SAT attempts, 160 SHA-distinct identities, 3 repetitions of 8 modes
independent C/Python conflict-chain counter, selected vs actual restart, no clause reset
same runner/core and pre-intervention telemetry comparison with monitor, forced50, R16, R21 inverse
formula-level wins and regressions >2x, missed forced50 wins, Spearman feature vs actual paired gain
SAT witnesses independently checked, cross-mode SAT/UNSAT agreement, no independent UNSAT certificate
external original Kissat/V15.3.1 reference separately compiled, not same binary
validation.hard_stop: If compile, smoke, native parity or any shard fails, do not claim valid aggregated result.
